:::{#exm-addition-not-distributive}
#### Addition does not distribute over multiplication

$$
\begin{aligned}
2 + (3 \times 4) &= 2 + 12 \\
&= 14,
\end{aligned}
$$

but

$$
\begin{aligned}
(2 + 3) \times (2 + 4) &= 5 \times 6 \\
&= 30.
\end{aligned}
$$

So @def-distributes-over fails with $\star = +$ and $\diamond = \times$.

:::
